description: This file defines the BuzzLikeOnShareModel class, a data model for representing 'like' interactions on social shares within the OrangeHRM's Buzz plugin API. It implements serialization and normalization traits and maps entity data to API schema with annotations.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareModel
classes.description: A model class providing serialization, filtering, and attribute mapping for Buzz like interactions on shares in the API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an entity and configures filters and attribute mappings based on the BuzzLikeOnShare entity.
